specification.purpose: Add support for Chrome tab groups with separate limits per group
requirements: Track tabs by group within each window
Allow setting limits per tab group
Ungrouped tabs have their own limit
Show group information in selector window
Update popup to show group limits

implementation_order: Update storage.js to handle group limits
Modify background.js to track tab groups
Update popup to show/set group limits
Enhance selector to display group information

storage_updates.getGroupLimit: Get limit for specific group in window
storage_updates.getGroupLimits: Get all group limits for a window

background_updates.tab_tracking: Track tabs by groupId (-1 for ungrouped)
background_updates.getTabsByGroup: Helper to count tabs per group

ui_changes: List active groups in current window
Special row for ungrouped tabs limit

display_changes: Sort: grouped tabs first, then ungrouped

code_examples.popup_group_section: Tab Group Limits

test_requirements: Verify moving tabs between groups updates counts
Selector shows tabs organized by group
important_notes: Tab groupId is -1 when not in a group
Groups can be collapsed - still count tabs
Consider group color in UI for visual consistency
